y1: The Roman governor Pilate found no fault in Jesus. There was a custom to release a prisoner during the festival, so he asked, “Should I release Jesus, or the robber Barabbas?”
y2: The crowd shouted, “Release Barabbas, and crucify Jesus!” To avoid responsibility, Pilate washed his hands and finally handed Jesus over. The sinful Barabbas went free, and the sinless Jesus died in his place.
y4: The soldiers put a crown of thorns on Jesus' head and mocked Him. Jesus was very tired, and it was hard for Him to carry the cross.
y5: Simon of Cyrene, who was passing by at that time, took Jesus' cross and carried it.
y7: Jesus was crucified on a hill called Golgotha. People mocked Him, saying, “If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
y8: From twelve noon until three in the afternoon, the whole land became dark. Jesus cried out with a loud voice and gave up His spirit. Jesus carried my sins and died.
y10: At that moment, the curtain of the temple was torn from top to bottom. When the earth shook, the Roman centurion guarding the cross said, “Truly, this was the Son of God!”
y11: In the evening, a rich man named Joseph wrapped Jesus' body in clean linen and placed it in a tomb cut out of rock, and closed it with a large stone. But this is not the end!
verse: “Truly, this was the Son of God!”
prayer: Jesus, thank You for carrying the cross and dying in my place even though You were sinless. Help me never forget the love You showed by giving Your life for me, who was set free like Barabbas. Like the centurion, I confess, “Jesus is truly the Son of God.” I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: Pilate. He was the Roman governor who ruled Judea. Pilate found no fault in Jesus.
d1: cross. It was a wooden tool the Romans used to execute criminals. Jesus carried the cross for us. Jesus carried the cross.
d2: Golgotha. It is a hill outside the city of Jerusalem, meaning “Skull”. Jesus was crucified at Golgotha.
d3: curtain. It was a thick cloth that covered the most holy place in the temple. The curtain of the temple was torn from top to bottom.
d4: tomb. It is a place where dead people are laid. Back then, it was cut out of rock. Joseph placed Jesus in a tomb.
